classes.name: TNF inhibitors
classes.description: Adalimumab and biosimilars (Humira, Hadlima, Hyrimoz, Cyltezo, Yusimry, Simlandi, Amjevita, unbranded adalimumab-adaz/-fkjp/-aacf), etanercept (Enbrel, Erelzi, Eticovo), certolizumab (Cimzia), golimumab (Simponi). Infliximab is infusion/medical benefit.
classes.plainDescription: A shot for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis or Crohn's/colitis.
classes.indication: RA, PsA, AS, psoriasis, Crohn's, UC

classes.name: IL-17 and IL-23 inhibitors
classes.description: Secukinumab (Cosentyx), ixekizumab (Taltz), bimekizumab (Bimzelx), brodalumab (Siliq); guselkumab (Tremfya), risankizumab (Skyrizi), tildrakizumab (Ilumya), ustekinumab and biosimilars (Stelara, Wezlana, Selarsdi, Pyzchiva, Otulfi, Imuldosa, Yesintek, Steqeyma).
classes.plainDescription: A shot for psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis or Crohn's/colitis.

classes.name: Oral JAK inhibitors
classes.description: Tofacitinib (Xeljanz, XR), upadacitinib (Rinvoq), baricitinib (Olumiant) for RA/PsA/UC; deucravacitinib (Sotyktu, TYK2) for psoriasis; apremilast (Otezla, PDE4) as an oral psoriasis alternative.
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis or colitis.

preferredAgent.sig: RA/PsA/AS: 40 mg subcutaneously every 2 weeks. Psoriasis: 80 mg once, then 40 mg every 2 weeks starting 1 week later. Crohn's/UC: 160 mg, then 80 mg 2 weeks later, then 40 mg every 2 weeks (label).
preferredAgent.plainSig: A shot every 2 weeks; starting doses depend on the condition.
